Name: Early Soul Sapper Ring
Author: ChottoMattte
Description:
[color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Ever felt like the [/color][b][color=#674ea7][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Soul_Sapper_Ring]Soul Sapper Ring[/url][/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] comes way too late in the game to actually be useful? By the time you unlock Ginger Island, you've usually found enough Stardrops that energy management is no longer a concern.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod balances that by making the ring available right when you need it most: [/color][b][color=#d4d4d8]in the early game![/color][/b]

[color=#a64d79][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][i]Content Patcher[/i][/url]﻿ installed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download [b][i]Early Soul Sapper Ring[/i][/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the downloaded file into the game's Mods folder.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]To uninstall, simply delete [CP] Early Soul Sapper Ring from your Mods folder. [/color]

[color=#ffe599][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Mail Delivery from Parents: Receive the Soul Sapper Ring early in your playthrough via a warm letter from Mom or Dad.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Fully Configurable (GMCM): Choose the exact year, season, and day you want the letter to arrive using the Generic Mod Config Menu.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Multilingual Support: Fully translated into English, Portuguese (Português), and Spanish (Español). (Mod language will change accordingly to your game language).[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][color=#d9ead3]How It Works [/color][/size]
[list]
[*]Install the mod and set your preferred arrival date in the GMCM menu (if you don't set it manually, the letter will arrive day 3 of Spring Year 1).[/*]
[*]Check your mailbox on that day to receive your parents' letter along with the Soul Sapper Ring.[/*]
[*]Enjoy recovering energy with every monster kill early in your mining adventure![/*]
[/list]
[color=#1155cc][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] [i][color=#d4d4d8](Optional, but recommended for changing the date in-game settings)[/color][/i][/*]
[/list]

[color=#85200c][size=4]Extras[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/gsgabs/CP-Early-Soul-Sapper-Ring]Mod's Github Repository[/url][/*]
[*]Please Endorse if you like it[/*]
[/list]
